agents.description: One fresh model call per original human participant. No demographic persona is assigned because the paper does not define one for the replay.

scripted_roles_note: None: the paper describes no confederates or experimenters acting in the task.
order: Study 2 treatment: pretest headline, then 30 headlines in random order. All other arms: 30 headlines in random order.
visibility: Each participant sees only the headlines, the question and the options; no other participant's data and no veracity labels.
n_semantics: run_sessions(n=...) runs n AI participants per arm.
replay_adaptations: Each participant's session is one prompt that presents the 30 headlines in a random order and collects all answers as one JSON object; the original showed one headline at a time.
Headlines are text only; the pictures and lede sentences are not available.
Survey instructions are replay scaffolding (materials.replay_frame), not the original text.
Individual-differences measures, COVID-19 questions, screeners and debriefing are not replayed.
Participants are not given a demographic persona; random assignment is replaced by an exact number of AI participants per arm.

Study 2 treatment: the pretest headline is text only (no picture) and is drawn at random from the four printed headlines per participant because the assignment rule is not stated (iss_s2_pretest_assign).
